items.body: An HTML-first, Bun-native renderer that builds static websites from routes and components.

items.summary: Does a site require client-side JavaScript?
items.body: No. The generated HTML remains readable and navigable without JavaScript.

items.summary: What does the build generate automatically?
items.body: Static routes, responsive images, SEO metadata, structured data, feeds, sitemaps, and agent-readable discovery files.
